rationale: With a unanimous vote and the Chief Justice emphasizing a narrow, administrable rule anchored in Strang and the statutory focus on how the money was obtained, Roberts is best positioned to keep the opinion tightly cabined to traditional agency/partnership imputation under nonbankruptcy law. The most likely separate writings would be concurrences (especially from Gorsuch, Sotomayor, or Thomas) stressing textualism/history or fairness limits and warning against extending nondischargeability beyond established imputation doctrines.
